Attached: bench-results-20270407.csv

Quick summary from the lab runs (seq=512, batch=1 unless noted). Numbers are steady-state p50 / p95 (ms), tokens/sec effective, and observed concurrency breakpoint (where p95 > 2x p50).

- H100 (full) -- p50: 42ms / p95: 110ms ; tokens/sec: 1,150 ; concurrency comfortable: 12 -> 24 with graceful tailing; cost-efficiency: highest performance per watt.
- A100 (full) -- p50: 95ms / p95: 220ms ; tokens/sec: 540 ; concurrency comfortable: 6 -> 12 ; cold-start penalty ~150-200ms extra TTFT.
- L40S (full) -- p50: 80ms / p95: 240ms ; tokens/sec: 680 ; concurrency comfortable: 8 -> 16 ; best $/token in batched modes (batch 8 throughput ~4.5k tokens/sec).

MIG runs (H100 / A100, 4g slice unless noted):
- H100-4g MIG -- p50: 68ms / p95: 140ms ; tokens/sec: 520 ; concurrency per-slice: 4 -> 8 ; lower variance under two-tenant load, but ~0.45x peak throughput vs full H100.
- A100-4g MIG -- p50: 130ms / p95: 300ms ; tokens/sec: 220 ; concurrency per-slice: 2 -> 6 ; memory pressure on 4g slice for seq=512 occasionally triggers OOM for batch=8.

Key observations:
- H100 full gives ~2x throughput vs A100 full for this model and much better TTFT and tail behavior.
- L40S is attractive for heavy batch workloads (when ACME allows batching) — cost per 1M tokens is lower, but interactive TTFT is worse than H100.
- MIG is a strong operational fit for multi-tenant predictability and reducing tail risk; however it sacrifices peak throughput and increases $/token for high-throughput needs.
- Cold-start dominates some TTFT rows on A100; recommend keeping warmed model instances on A100 if ACME needs to use A100.

Files included in CSV: per-run sample rate, GPU util, max memory used, latency histograms, warm vs cold runs.

Recommendation (short):
- If ACME prioritizes interactive low-latency UI: H100 full -> canary -> Dedicated commit.
- If ACME prioritizes lowest $/token for batch scoring: L40S + aggressive batching + asynchronous user experience.
- For mixed multi-tenant pools: use H100 with MIG for lower tiers and full GPUs for priority lanes.

I'll attach the raw logs to the Drive link and prepare a 1-pager before EOD.

-Marcus
